items.title: 🌙 Kimi K3 发布：开源 2.8T 模型，前端编程在 Arena 中超越 Fable 5 跃居第一  月之暗面发布 Kimi K3，全球首个开源的 2.8
items.title_zh: Kimi K3：首个开源2.8万亿参数模型，登顶前端编程排行榜
items.title_en: Kimi K3: First Open-Source 2.8T Model, Tops Frontend Code Arena
items.summary: Kimi K3 is the first open-source 2.8 trillion parameter model, achieving top scores in code generation benchmarks with a novel attention architecture.

items.title: Fastjson 1.x 被曝无 gadget 高危 RCE 漏洞  安全研究人员 Kirill Firsov 披露，Fastjson 1.2.68 至 1.2
items.title_zh: Fastjson 1.x 曝无 gadget 高危 RCE 漏洞
items.title_en: Critical RCE in Fastjson 1.x Without Gadget or AutoType
items.summary: Critical remote code execution vulnerability discovered in Fastjson 1.x versions 1.2.68-1.2.83, exploitable without gadget or autoType, requiring upgrade to Fastjson2.

items.summary: vLLM v0.26.0 with 411 commits, new Inkling model family, DeepSeek-V4 optimizations, and flexible attention backend.

items.title: Our position on open-weights models

items.summary: Anthropic clarifies they do not advocate banning open-weights models but proposes mandatory safety testing and cracking down on distillation, drawing significant criticism from the community.

items.title: Evaluated 6 frontier LLMs (GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini Pro/Flash, Grok 4.3) on political, gender, and racial bias across 8 benchmarks (~20,600 examples) [R]
items.title_zh: 六大前沿LLM偏见评估：所有模型包括Grok均为左倾
items.title_en: 6 Frontier LLMs Evaluated for Bias: All Left-Leaning Including Grok
items.summary: Evaluates political, gender, and racial bias in 6 frontier LLMs across 8 benchmarks, finding all models left-leaning including Grok despite its self-reported right-leaning stance.

items.title_zh: 中芯国际测试中国首台国产DUV光刻机
items.title_en: SMIC Tests China's First Domestic DUV Lithography Machine
